main_text.l: missionem peccatorum. Sanctifico meipsum, id est, offero me tibi in sanctam victi-mam.

Johan. 6. 51. Panis autem, quem ego dabo, caro mea est, quam dabo, scilicet crucifigendam pro mundi vita, id est, ad ꝑmeren-dam vitam aeternam mundo. Caro autem Christi crucifixa, est cibus nobis vivificus, quia est personaliter unita Filio Dei, fuit aequivalens pretium ad satisfaciendum pro nostris peccatis, quę ipsi fuerant a Deo imposita, & fide manducatur ad salutem.

Hoc certe non tantum significat ge-neraliter, propter nostram salutem, vel nostri caussa, eum esse mortuum, quo modo & nos animam pro fratribus ponere jubemur, 1. Joh. 3. 16. & dum omnia sustinemus propter electos, ut est 2. Tim. 2. 10, & Col.1. 24. Sed significat, propter peccata nostra, ipsi imputata, traditum esse in mortem. Sic enim legimus Rom. 4. 25. Christus traditus est propter lapsus nostros, Christus à Deo Patre traditus est in mortem, ad expiandum nostra peccata.

page.notes: The handwritten "276" at the top right is not printed text and is left out. The reference "Testim. 4." and the note "Vt docent Adversarii." are marginal notes. The reading "ge-" with the note mark is placed where the note stands beside that line. "caussa" and "impolita" were read as printed. The word "electos" is read from italic type. Possible doubt: the numbers in "Rom. 4. 25." and "Col.1. 24." may have different spacing in print.
